rules.rule: ARDENT_CLI_DEVELOPMENT.md's "The PostgreSQL URL is the command contract" records the approved interface decision. Flag changes that replace the positional URL with host, user, or password flags, reject password-bearing URLs as a temporary restriction, or require the later credential-delivery work to change the command shape. Treat visibility of a password-bearing URL in shell history or the process argument vector as the documented and accepted interface tradeoff, not a standalone defect. Until credential delivery lands, flag any path that transmits or stores the URL password or stops telling the user that credential delivery and replication readiness remain pending.
